keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Bart Meijers (Borac Banja Luka) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Borac Banja Luka 1, Atalanta 0. Luka Juricic (Borac Banja Luka) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Omar Sijaric.
Goal! Borac Banja Luka 2, Atalanta 0. Matej Deket (Borac Banja Luka) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner following a fast break.
Omar Sijaric (Borac Banja Luka) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Jonathan Rowe (Atalanta) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Atalanta. Franck Kessie replaces Éderson.
Substitution, Atalanta. Raoul Bellanova replaces Lorenzo Bernasconi.
Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Borac Banja Luka. Sandi Ogrinec replaces Milos Jojic.
Substitution, Borac Banja Luka. Viktor Rogan replaces Omar Sijaric.
Substitution, Atalanta. Nikola Krstovic replaces Gianluca Scamacca.
Substitution, Atalanta. Charles De Ketelaere replaces Giacomo Raspadori.
Delay in match because of an injury Branimir Cipetic (Borac Banja Luka).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Borac Banja Luka. Abel Pascual replaces Branimir Cipetic because of an injury.
Abel Pascual (Borac Banja Luka) is shown the red card.
Substitution, Borac Banja Luka. Sinisa Sanicanin replaces Matej Deket.
Delay in match (Borac Banja Luka).
Substitution, Atalanta. Eljif Elmas replaces Mario Pasalic.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
